items.duty_text: Establish the position of New York city housing authority liaison within the department.

Delineate the roles and responsibilities of the department and the New York city housing authority regarding repairs at senior centers sponsored by the department and located at the New York city housing authority.
Establish a system to receive comments and complaints with respect to programs and facilities sponsored by the department and located at a New York city housing authority location.
Make recommendations to the commissioner with respect to improving programs and facilities that receive funding from the department to serve older adult public housing residents.
Coordinate with the New York city housing authority about any other matters impacting older adult public housing residents.

Create and maintain a culturally appropriate pamphlet written in plain English to educate older adults about their rights, in consultation with relevant agencies and relevant community-based organizations.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Post and update the pamphlet on the department’s website, make it available in designated citywide languages, and ensure it is posted on relevant city websites and platforms.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Conduct culturally appropriate outreach on the pamphlet in designated citywide languages, including mailing, informational sessions, distribution to organizations and institutions serving older adults, and targeted outreach to paid care workers and informal caregivers.
items.deadline_text: Beginning no later than 30 days after the commissioner publishes the pamphlet as required by subdivision b of this section

items.duty_text: The commissioner shall require each older adult center to conduct a survey of the languages spoken by older adults within a one-mile radius of such center.

The commissioner shall require each older adult center to develop and conduct specific programming for older adults in each language spoken by 20 percent or more of the older adults responding to the required survey.

Post and update as necessary the required NYC Care information on the department’s website, make it available in designated citywide languages, and post the pamphlet on the 311 Citizen Center website.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Develop and implement a plan to support aging in place within naturally occurring retirement communities and neighborhood naturally occurring retirement communities.
items.deadline_text: Within 2 years of completing such study

items.duty_text: Post the study and plan on the department’s website.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Study the feasibility of creating older adult information and service centers to expand access to services and information for older adults, including the specified location, siting considerations, services, benefits, and constraints assessments.

Ensure covered services made available online or digitally are accessible through non-digital means at the same level of functionality, including by phone and in paper form, with phone support allowing applications, information, guidance, and mailed paper materials, and paper services available at older adult centers and by mail upon request.
Provide access to covered services through non-digital means in the designated citywide languages.
